system.description: Most sorcerers consider the Blood Lash a weapon of last resort, for the spell can be cast only if the sorcerer bears a bleeding wound--at least one unbound, unhealed level of lethal damage. The character may wound himself if he must (this selfinflicted damage does not trigger reflexive Charms of defense). Blood from the sorcerer's wounds surges outward, forming a lash of blood. This effect inflicts another health level of lethal damage, which cannot be healed until the caster ends the spell or the spell's scene-long duration expires. This whip of blood can make Melee or Martial Arts attacks. Its reach is a number of yards equal to the sorcerer's Willpower. It inflicts dice of lethal damage equal to (caster's Strength + Essence) + the number of lethal health levels the caster currently suffers. Its full traits are as follows: BLOOD LASH Speed Accuracy Damage Defense Rate +1 (Varies)L +1 Tags M, N, R
